description: This file defines a generic LRUCache class implementing a least-recently-used cache with TTL support, cache management, and logging integration.

classes.name: LRUCache
classes.description: A generic thread-safe LRU cache with TTL and size override features.

methods.name: allCachesEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables all cache instances.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the cache with optional TTL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value by key, updating its position in the FIFO queue.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a key from the cache.

methods.name: setMaxSizeOverride
methods.description: Overrides the maximum size for all cache instances.
